content_zh:
忽然间。
一道闪电劈在神龙侯府的后山脚下的茅屋顶上。
“轰隆隆！”
转而，茅屋下一张两块门板拼凑起来的床上一名少年突然弹身坐起，满头冷汗，大口的喘着粗气。
“我去，吓死宝宝了。”
话刚说完，少年脸色一凛，看茅草屋内的陈设顿时就傻X了。
“这TM是哪啊？”
“不对啊，我明明就在我的狗窝里打着游戏，随随便便就将一头BOSS给爆了，然后……”少年没有再‘然后’下去，而是在想，“那头BOSS可是终极BOSS啊，一定爆出神器，老子叱咤风云，发家致富，迎娶白富美走向人生巅峰的时候到了。”
“等等！”
少年再次惊愕住，“好像有道闪电劈在我的主机上，我还没有来得急查看BOSS爆出什么，我就昏迷过去了？”
也在此时。
少年的脑海开始剧烈的疼痛起来。
各种记忆碎片填鸭式的用尽脑海中。
“九岁就突破五级战士，果然是皇城第一天才，真不愧是神龙将军的后代啊。”
“皇上赐婚，把南宫燕赐给龙飞，天才配美女，绝配啊。”
“皇城第一天才龙飞被神秘人重伤，龙神精血被抽离，丹田破碎，筋脉郁结，修为直接倒退为零了。”
“没有用，太还丹也无力回天，丹田破碎，从此以后他只能做个凡人了。”
“爹，我坚决反对再耗费财力去医治龙飞，他现在不过是一个废物，他现在已经十五岁，就算医治好了，也是一个废物……”
“龙飞，你以前不是挺嚣张的吗？怎么了？被本少爷踩在脚下的感觉怎么样啊？哈哈哈……”
“瞧瞧这废物，连街上的乞丐都打不过，真给神龙侯府丢脸，要是我的话直接死了算了。”

“太爷闭死关了。”
“从今天开始，断掉龙飞一切补给，想要吃饭，自己动手去挣，龙家不养废物。”
“啊……”
记忆碎片慢慢的拼接起来。
最后一幕龙飞被龙傲一脚踢飞，脑袋撞在一块石碑上昏迷过去。
少年彻底傻眼了，“老天爷啊，我不过是杀了游戏中的一头BOSS，你有必要这样惩罚我吗？”
“杀了一头BOSS，东西爆了什么不知道，这下子把自己爆到异界来了，而且还变成一个废物。”
龙飞很不爽。
相当的不爽。
根据记忆他清楚的知道自己有一个非常牛逼的身份，神龙侯府继承人。
神龙侯府。
第一任府主，龙战天。
凭借一把开山刀，只身进入洪荒域，斩杀一头龙神，以龙神精血淬炼肉身，成为当时天武大陆第一龙神战士。追随南宫傲，斩邪魔，诛异兽，在这混乱一片的领域杀出一个霸气冲天，征战十八年，率领龙家军所向披靡，帮助南宫傲建立现在的火璃王朝。被封为龙神侯，建立神龙侯府，享有万世爵位。神龙侯府也因此得名。
据传，龙战天获得龙神血脉传承，龙家每一代子弟当中必有龙神战士诞生。
而他就是这一代的龙神战士。
九岁便突破五级战士，十二岁八级战士，十四岁已经成为二级战师，成为火璃王朝第一天才。
各种赞美，各种巴结，龙飞成了龙家最为重要宝贝。
好景不长，神秘强者的突然出现，一招击碎龙飞的丹田，并且将他血液中的龙神血脉给抽离出体。
天才瞬间变成废材。
这一年来受尽欺凌，家族内的兄弟姐妹不待见，家族外那些曾经巴结他的人嘲笑，耍弄。

他也成为火璃城最大的笑柄。
龙家因为他蒙羞。
太爷闭死关之后，他在龙家的地位更是一落千丈，就连一个下人都不如。
三天前。
更是被龙傲一脚踹飞，理由竟然是，他看了一眼龙傲身边的女人，就因为看了一眼！
可见他有多么的苦逼。
龙飞想死的心都有了，“风光的时候不把老子弄来，现在变成废物了就让老子穿越来，老天爷啊，你这是要玩死我的节奏啊。”
天武大陆，以武为尊。
丹田，就是吸纳天地真气之所在，淬炼身体，突破修为，丹田破碎就如同判下死刑，无法修炼，永无出头之日，这一年来的遭遇就足以证明这一切了。
“就算丹田完好，可是我一个宅男根本不懂什么叫修炼啊，如果比玩游戏的话，一只手都能打爆一切不服者，这个世界连电脑都不知道，更不要说是网游了。”龙飞苦逼，脑袋还传来阵阵疼痛。

content_en:
suddenly.
A bolt of lightning struck the thatched roof at the foot of the back hill of Shenlonghou Mansion.
"Boom!"
Then, a young man suddenly jumped up and sat up on the bed made of two door panels under the hut, his head covered in cold sweat and breathing heavily.
"I'm going to scare the baby to death."
As soon as he finished speaking, the young man's face turned stern, and he immediately felt stupid when he looked at the furnishings in the thatched house.
"Where is this?"
"That's not right. I was playing a game in my kennel and casually destroyed a BOSS. Then..." The young man did not go on 'then', but was thinking, "That BOSS is the ultimate BOSS. He must explode a magical weapon. It's time for me to dominate the world, make a fortune, marry Bai Fumei and reach the pinnacle of life."
"Wait!"
The young man was shocked again, "It seemed like a bolt of lightning struck my host. Before I could even check what the BOSS revealed, I passed out?"
Also at this time.
The young man's mind began to feel severe pain.
All kinds of memory fragments are crammed into my mind.
"He broke through to the fifth level of warrior at the age of nine. He is indeed the number one genius in the imperial city. He is truly worthy of being a descendant of General Shenlong."
"The emperor granted marriage to Nangong Yan to Long Fei. A genius and a beauty, a perfect match."
"Long Fei, the first genius of the Imperial City, was seriously injured by a mysterious man. The essence and blood of the Dragon God were extracted. His dantian was shattered, his muscles and veins were stagnated, and his cultivation level dropped to zero."
"It's useless. The Taihuan Dan can't save him. His Dantian is broken. From now on, he can only be a mortal."
"Dad, I firmly oppose spending money and resources to treat Long Fei anymore. He is just a waste now. He is already fifteen years old. Even if he is cured, he is still a waste..."
"Long Fei, weren't you quite arrogant before? What's wrong? How does it feel to be stepped on by this young master? Hahaha..."
"Look at this loser. He can't even beat a beggar on the street. He really embarrasses the Shenlong Hou Mansion. If it were me, he would just die."
"My grandpa is in seclusion."
"From today on, I will cut off all supplies from Long Fei. If you want to eat, you can earn it yourself. The Long family does not raise waste."
"Ah..."
The memory fragments slowly came together.
In the last scene, Long Fei was kicked away by Long Ao, and his head hit a stone tablet and he passed out.
The young man was completely dumbfounded, "Oh my God, I just killed a BOSS in the game. Do you need to punish me like this?"
"I killed a BOSS, and I don't know what it exploded. Now I exploded into another world, and turned into a waste."
Long Fei was very unhappy.
Quite unhappy.
From his memory, he clearly knew that he had a very impressive identity, the heir to the Shenlong Hou Mansion.
Shenlonghou Mansion.
The first palace master, Long Zhantian.
With a machete, he entered the wilderness alone, killed a dragon god, tempered his body with the dragon god's essence and blood, and became the number one dragon god warrior in the Tianwu Continent at that time. Follow Nangong Ao, slay demons and strange beasts, and create a domineering figure in this chaotic field. After eighteen years of fighting, he led the Long family army to be invincible and helped Nangong Ao establish the current Huoli Dynasty. He was named the Dragon God Marquis, established the Shenlong Marquis Mansion, and enjoyed the title of eternity. Shenlonghou Mansion also got its name from this.
It is said that Long Zhantian has inherited the bloodline of the Dragon God, and a Dragon God warrior must be born among every generation of descendants of the Long family.
And he is the Dragon God warrior of this generation.
He broke through to the fifth-level warrior at the age of nine, became an eighth-level warrior at the age of twelve, and became a second-level combat master at the age of fourteen, becoming the number one genius of the Fire Li Dynasty.
With all kinds of praise and flattery, Long Fei became the most important treasure of the Long family.
The good times didn't last long, but the mysterious strongman suddenly appeared, shattered Long Fei's Dantian with one move, and pulled out the Dragon God blood in his blood.
Geniuses become useless in an instant.
I have been bullied a lot this year, and my brothers and sisters in the family are not welcome.Outside, those who once flattered him laughed at and teased him.
He also became the biggest laughing stock in Huoli City.
The Long family was humiliated because of him.
After the master went into seclusion, his status in the Long family plummeted, and he was not even as good as a servant.
Three days ago.
He was even kicked away by Long Ao. The reason turned out to be that he glanced at the woman next to Long Ao just because of one look!
It shows how hard he is.
Long Fei wanted to die, "If you didn't bring me here when you were in glory, and now that I've become a waste, let me come through time. Oh my God, you are trying to kill me."
In Tianwu Continent, martial arts is the most respected.
The dantian is where the true energy of heaven and earth is absorbed, the body is tempered, and the cultivation level is broken. A broken dantian is like a death sentence, unable to practice, and never able to get ahead. The experiences of this year are enough to prove all this.
"Even if the Dantian is intact, I am an otaku who doesn't know what cultivation is. If it were a game, I could defeat anyone who disobeys with one hand. This world doesn't even know about computers, let alone online games." Long Fei struggled, and there was still pain in his head.
